article.title: A Referendum on Freedom w/Jane Fonda & Nadine Bloch
article.author: Scot Nakagawa
article.content: When authoritarian regimes consolidate power, they come for the artists first because artists name what is happening, make people feel what is true, and keep moral imagination alive when everything else is being suppressed. In this episode, Scot talks with two people who have spent their lives at the intersection of art and resistance: Jane Fonda, one of the most consequential activist artists of… Source
